## 1. Menu bar — Qt interface (Windows & Linux)

VLC 3.0.x Qt menu bar: **Media, Playback, Audio, Video, Subtitle, Tools, View, Help** (doc 02 §3.4 expectation; corroborated by [Q] Alt-access keys: Media Alt+M, Playback Alt+L, Audio Alt+A, Subtitle Alt+T ("tools menu / Subtitle menu" — wiki comment garbled), Tools Alt+S, View Alt+I, Help Alt+H; **Video menu access key not documented** [VERIFY]).

## 3. Context menus, tray, modes

### 3.1 VLC playlist context menu [UG:Playlist]

Play · Add file · Add directory · Remove Selected · Stream (→ Stream Output) · Save (→ Stream Output) · Information (→ Media Information) · Sort (by Title) · Open Folder (expand node) · Add Node.

### 3.2 VLC playback-surface (video right-click) — [VERIFY]

Public docs consulted do not enumerate the 3.0.x Qt video-surface context menu [VERIFY V-02]. It is expected to mirror Playback/Audio/Video/Subtitle/Tools/View/Help menu subsets [VERIFY]. **Our replacement is design-authored** (§6 crosswalk): `right-click menu.svg` [D] — Play (Space), Stop (S), Previous Item (P), Next Item (N), Record (R — see D-1), Hide UI (Ctrl+\), Playback ▸, Video ▸, Audio ▸, Subtitle ▸, More Settings, Playlist ▸, Open Media, Quit VLC (Ctrl+Q).

### 3.3 System tray [UG:Interface]

Tray icon right-click → **Quit (Alt-F4)** [Windows-era doc]. Further tray menu items [VERIFY V-03]. Systray is a desktop-shell integration for us (Tauri), not an engine capability.

### 3.4 Modes

- **Fullscreen controller**: auto-hidden controls, `i` shows controller in fullscreen [B `key-intf-show`] + [D KS-dialog row "Show interface controls in fullscreen — I"].
- **Minimal View** Ctrl+H [Q]; **DirectX Wallpaper** w [UG:Video, Windows]; **Skins2** — alternative skinnable interface (recorded as `interface` capability; **expected `unsupported` for Lumen by design**, doc 02 §3.4).
- **macOS Controller window** + Window menu helpers [MAC, stale].
- Design-only modes: **Music mode** (`Player - Music*.svg`), **Miniplayer** (`Miniplayer.svg`), **hide UI** (`Player - hide UI.svg`), **Light theme**, **Onboarding** — no VLC equivalent needed in the oracle.

## 4. macOS menu conventions (per-platform delta)

From [MAC] (stale page — all [VERIFY] against pinned macOS 3.0.23):

- Menu bar has **10 menus**: VLC (About, Check for Update, Preferences, Add Interface), File (Open File, Quick Open File, Open Disk, Open Network, Services Discovery, Streaming & Export Wizard, Save Playlist), Edit (standard Cut/Copy/Paste/Clear/Select All/Special Characters), View, Playback (Play Stop, Step Forward, Jump to time, Previous, Random, Repeat, Add Folder, Program, Title, Chapter), Audio (Volume Up/Down/Mute, Visualisations, Audio Device, Audio Track, Audio Channels), Video (Half/Normal/Double/Fit to screen, Full Screen, Float on top, Snapshot, Deinterlace, Post-processing, Aspect Ratio, Crop, Video device, Video track, Subtitles track), **Subtitles**, Window (Minimise, Close, Controller, Playlist, Information, Extended Controls, Equaliser, Bookmarks, Messages, Bring All to Front), Help (Read Me, Online Documentation, Report a bug, Online Forum, Make a donation, licences).
- macOS key conventions observed on the page: ⌘+F fullscreen; ⌘+Shift+←/→ ≈ 1-minute jumps; ⌘+Ctrl+←/→ ≈ 10-second jumps; **F/G = audio delay down/up; H/J = subtitle delay down/up** (differs from Linux J/K audio, G/H subtitle — see keymap `[platform_overrides.macos]`, all [VERIFY]).

## 5. Hotkeys inventory (VLC 3.0.23 defaults)

### 5.1 Method

1. **Option names + descriptions [B]:** `vlc -I dummy --longhelp --advanced` → "Hot keys" section: 222 options = 111 actions × (`key-*` + `global-key-*`).
2. **Default values [B]:** `vlc -I dummy --reset-config --config <fresh file> --play-and-exit vlc://quit` → the written config contains all defaults (commented lines = default values). All 111 `global-key-*` defaults are **empty** — VLC 3.0.23 ships with **no global hotkeys bound** [GK documents how users set them].
3. **Cross-check [Q]:** QtHotkeys wiki table (public). Agreements and divergences recorded in §5.2/§7.
4. **Jump sizes [B]:** extrashort 3 s, short 10 s, medium 60 s, long 300 s; mouse-wheel modes: vertical = volume control, horizontal = position control [B `hotkeys-y/x-wheel-mode`].

### 5.3 Unbound-by-default actions (recorded, no seed entries)

`key-subpos-up`, `key-subpos-down` (subtitle vertical position), `key-viewpoint-roll-clock`, `key-viewpoint-roll-anticlock` (360° roll), `key-intf-boss` (boss key), and all 111 `global-key-*`.

### 5.4 Per-platform status (G6)

- **Linux:** complete — binary-observed (§5.2), the seed's primary source.
- **Windows:** expected to equal the Linux core defaults (same core hotkey table; `Ctrl` vs `ctrl` case-insignificance is presentational) — **[VERIFY V-04]** via the Windows runbook (`--reset-config` dump).
- **macOS:** core defaults compiled per-platform may differ; [MAC] documents ⌘-based jump/delay/fullscreen variants (§4) — all **[VERIFY V-05]**. The seed carries `[platform_overrides.macos]` with 9 [VERIFY] entries and the Ctrl→Cmd modifier rendering rule.
- **Qt menu-level accelerators** (Ctrl+B/C/E/I/J/L/M/N/O/P/R/S/T/U/V/X/Y, Ctrl+Shift+W, Alt+M/L/A/T/S/I/H): [Q] only — **[VERIFY V-06]** against the pinned Qt plugin (headless pin excludes `vlc-plugin-qt`).

### 5.5 Doc-vs-binary discrepancies (binary wins per D-003 "clean-room-observable")

- **B-1:** [Q] says Shift+←/→ = "Jump 5 seconds"; binary default `extrashort-jump-size=3` → **3 s** (wiki stale). Design `Settings - controls.svg` agrees with the binary ("Very short skip 3 s").
- **B-2:** subtitle-scale help-string swap (§5.2 footnote).
- **B-4:** [UG:Open_Media] protocol list contains "RDMP" — verbatim transcription retained; probable wiki typo for RTMP. Does not affect our UI.

## 7. Design-vs-VLC accelerator conflicts (doc 08 §1 follow-up; D-003: design wins)

| ID | Key | Design says | VLC 3.0.23 says | Resolution (seeded) | UX consequence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C-01 | ← / → | Seek Backward/Forward (Onboarding-2) | bare arrows = disc-menu navigation (`key-nav-*`) | design wins; disc-menu nav needs an `in-disc-menu` gate [PROPOSAL Q4] | DVD/BD menu navigation must remain reachable; seek on arrows matches browser/mpv expectations |
| C-02 | ↑ / ↓ | Increase/Decrease Volume (Onboarding-2) | `Ctrl+Up`/`Ctrl+Down` (`key-vol-*`) | design wins; VLC Ctrl+arrows freed (no collision with Ctrl+Left/Right medium seek) | VLC muscle-memory users must relearn; ↑/↓ matches doc 05 §8.2 proposal |
| C-03 | < / > | Previous/Next Item (Onboarding-2) | `n`/`p` (`key-next`/`key-prev`) | both kept — N/P is *also* design-specified (KS dialog) and equals VLC; </> added | none (superset); D-2 recorded |
| C-04 | L | Show/Hide File Browser (Onboarding-2) | `l` = Normal/Loop/Repeat (`key-loop`) | design wins; repeat-cycle left **unbound** (Repeat stays a customize-panel button) | VLC users lose the repeat-cycle key; recommend design owner confirms intent [VERIFY] |
| C-05 | Ctrl+\ vs Ctrl+H | Hide UI (right-click menu.svg) | Minimal View Ctrl+H (QtHotkeys) | both kept distinct; [PROPOSAL] fold decision for Lead | two similar chrome-hiding modes may confuse; doc 08 §1.5 flagged the same family |
| C-06 | Shift+F1 | About VLC (menu.svg) | no documented About accelerator | design wins [VERIFY vs pinned Qt] | none |
| C-07 | Ctrl+C | Open Capture Device (menu.svg, = VLC) | same (QtHotkeys) | kept (both sources agree) — flagged in doc 08 §1.5 as copy-convention conflict | text-copy users inside the player must use platform-safe alternatives; capture is feature-gated v1 so the key renders disabled-from-data |
| C-08 | , / . | Previous/Next Frame (Onboarding-2) | `e` = next frame only (`key-frame-next`) | design wins; `e` freed; frame-prev is a **new capability** (doc 05 §2.4 already models Previous) | parity gain vs VLC |
| C-09 | Q | Show/Hide Queue (Onboarding-2) | no VLC binding | adopted; coexists with Ctrl+Q quit | none |

**Design-internal inconsistencies:**

| ID | Surfaces | Conflict | Resolution |
|---|---|---|---|
| D-1 | `right-click menu.svg` "Record — R" vs `Onboarding-2.svg` "Record — SHIFT+R" | Record accelerator | Shift+R seeded (Onboarding-2 **and** VLC agree); context-menu value assumed simplified display [VERIFY-DESIGN with file owner] |
| D-2 | `Keyboard Shortcuts.svg` "Next/Previous track — N/P" vs `Onboarding-2.svg` "Previous/Next Item — < / >" | next/prev keys | both kept (lossless; N/P = VLC parity) |
| D-3 | `Audio - Stereo Widener.svg` Feedback mock "0.2 %" vs VLC default `stereowiden-feedback=0.3` [B] | mock value vs default | engine default 0.3; design mock value treated as placeholder (not a keymap issue; recorded for doc 08 fidelity work) |
